incidents.name: SEAMAN transfer business-logic flaw
incidents.notes: SEAMAN's transfer() triggers a GVC buy-back sized from the pair's live reserves on every transfer, so the attacker repeatedly forced that internal swap and drained the GVC/USDT pool.

sources.ref: onchain review: SEAMAN 0x6bc9b4976ba6f8C9574326375204eE469993D038 created 2022-06-29T04:08:06Z by 0x3abe7c2c88d4b1a536a460b5c9cf40b1eaa1de6d, unrelated to attack sender 0x4b1f47be1f678076f447585beba025e3a046a9fa; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 8,585.75 USDT left 0x6637914482670f91f43025802b6755f27050b0a6 and 7,781.78 USDT reached the attack contract.
